instruction: Cinematic video still, medium shot. In an indoor studio, the man in the black vest (R2) stands on the left, dancing with a slight smile and gesturing with his hands. Beside him on the right, the woman in the red fringed dress (R1) poses with her hands raised to shoulder height, palms open, looking surprised with an open mouth. They dance side-by-side without physical contact. On the far-left edge, a small cropped portion of an arm is visible. The scene is illuminated by soft, colorful studio lighting with a vibrant pink and purple gradient background.
